claim: After removing source-level mean differences, the frozen model's prediction response to target SSIM is more compressed on thin-line and arc-stroke interference than on the original blur/noise reference conditions, and the interference response is itself materially below one-to-one.
design_type: observational calibration analysis of the frozen model; no model fit, refit or calibration
primary_estimand_definition: Mean over eligible source groups of (within-source OLS slope of prediction on ssim_target across the eight original blur/noise rows minus the corresponding slope across the eight interference rows); each source contributes equally.
independent_unit: source group: one font rendered with one committed text case
reference_condition: original Gaussian blur and Gaussian noise primary rows from the same source
splits: evaluation-only confirmatory set C; no model fitting; source groups are never split across analysis sets
support_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% source-grouped percentile CI for theta_h1 has lower bound > 0.10, the simultaneous CI for the mean interference slope has upper bound < 0.80, and both thin-line and arc-stroke mean slopes have point estimates < 1.0.
falsify_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% CI for theta_h1 has upper bound <= 0.00, or the simultaneous CI for the mean interference slope has lower bound >= 0.90.
inconclusive_rule: Any result not meeting the support or falsification rule; also if fewer than 90% of planned source groups are eligible or the precision target is not met.
secondary_metrics: mean within-source interference slope for thin lines and for arc strokes separately; mean within-source original blur/noise slope; source-level intercepts and mean bias; residual-target Spearman correlation by family; s4 target-prediction gap; s4 large-error proportion at the predeclared 0.20 exploratory threshold; interference MAE, RMSE, R2 and bias; source-level squared-error concentration
diagnostic_metrics: conditional calibration by severity rung; prediction/target SD ratio by source; paired condition contrasts within source; comparison against the already observed M8C values, explicitly exploratory
main_confounders: source composition and target range differ across fonts and cases; thin-line and arc-stroke severity ladders have unequal target gaps; the M5C training distribution does not include the full interference ladder, so distribution shift is an alternative explanation; target SSIM is a synthetic reference metric, not a perceptual scale; a slope is a summary of a possibly nonlinear calibration curve
what_cannot_be_separated: This design cannot separate attenuation caused by training-distribution shift from attenuation caused by model capacity, target construction or feature limitations. It also cannot establish that attenuation is the sole or main source of interference error.
new_data_required: Confirmatory set C with new source groups, new cases, new render/corruption seeds and the frozen champion evaluated zero-shot. C must include complete thin-line, arc-stroke, blur and noise ladders for every eligible source.
followup_if_supported: A separately approved intervention-development protocol may test a controlled calibration or retraining intervention on source-disjoint development data, with independent evaluation. This protocol does not authorise model changes.
followup_if_falsified: Deprioritise the attenuation mechanism and redirect the next milestone to a different preregistered error source; do not calibrate or retrain on this basis.
followup_if_inconclusive: Revise precision, target-range overlap or family-specific design in a new planning protocol; do not treat a wide interval as support.

claim: The frozen eight-feature representation does not adequately distinguish interference-induced edge/sharpness changes from benign image-quality variation, so an interference-specific absolute-error excess remains after matching on the frozen features and target SSIM within source.
design_type: observational matched diagnostic analysis; no feature change and no model fit
independent_variable: interference versus benign condition after matching on the eight frozen features and target SSIM
primary_estimand_definition: Mean over eligible source groups of the within-source mean paired difference |ssim_target - prediction| for matched interference rows minus matched benign rows; pairs are within the same source and a target-SSIM bin of width 0.05, selected by nearest neighbour on the eight frozen features after pilot-fixed standardisation, with a 0.25 SD caliper and deterministic tie-break; each source contributes equally.
primary_estimand_units: SSIM units on the 0-1 scale (absolute residual difference)
independent_unit: source group: one font rendered with one committed text case
analysis_unit: matched row pair, aggregated within source before source-level averaging
reference_condition: benign primary rows from the same source: Gaussian blur and Gaussian noise; geometric primary is a secondary reference only
splits: evaluation-only confirmatory set C; matching uses covariates only and never predictions or residuals
support_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% source-grouped percentile CI for theta_h2 has lower bound > 0.02, post-match absolute standardised mean difference is <= 0.10 for target and every one of the eight frozen features, at least 80% of eligible interference rows are matched, and at least 90% of eligible source groups contribute at least one pair.
falsify_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% CI for theta_h2 has upper bound <= 0.02.
inconclusive_rule: Any result not meeting the support or falsification rule; also matching overlap or balance failure, coverage below the predeclared thresholds, or precision target not met.
secondary_metrics: signed matched residual difference; per-feature post-match standardised mean differences; target-SSIM post-match standardised mean difference; geometric-primary secondary reference; per-font and per-severity descriptive matched contrasts
diagnostic_metrics: exploratory within-font and within-severity rank associations of laplacian_variance and edge_density with absolute error; feature correlation structure and redundancy; unmatched-row counts and reasons; comparison against M9A exploratory associations, explicitly exploratory
main_confounders: the eight features are correlated with target SSIM, source content and severity; matching on features and target can induce selection and regression-to-the-mean effects; benign blur/noise and interference differ in mechanism, not only in feature values; the feature vector may not contain the relevant texture information at all; target-SSIM bin width and feature caliper are finite-resolution design choices
what_cannot_be_separated: This design cannot identify which feature, if any, causes the error, whether the random forest uses a feature as a benign cue, or whether omitted texture information would repair the problem. It also cannot separate feature inadequacy from training-distribution shift.
new_data_required: Confirmatory set C with new source groups, new cases, new render/corruption seeds and the frozen eight-feature extractor. The pilot must demonstrate adequate feature/target overlap and fix the feature standardisation and caliper before C is generated.
followup_if_supported: A separately approved feature-diagnostic or development protocol may test feature-level explanations with independent source-grouped train/validation/test data. No feature may be selected on C, and no feature addition is authorised by this protocol.
followup_if_falsified: Deprioritise the conflation mechanism and do not add or replace features on this basis.
followup_if_inconclusive: Improve overlap, matching resolution or precision in a new pilot; do not treat unmatched or imbalanced data as support.

claim: Apparent font-related interference error differences persist after matching on target SSIM, text case and interference condition/severity, and are ordered by a predeclared glyph-stroke group. This is a conditional association under the fixed renderer, not a causal font effect.
design_type: observational matched font-group comparison; new fonts evaluated zero-shot
independent_variable: predeclared new thin-stroke font group versus predeclared new thick-stroke font group
primary_estimand_definition: Mean over eligible matched cases of (mean matched |ssim_target - prediction| for the predeclared thin-stroke new fonts minus mean matched |ssim_target - prediction| for the predeclared thick-stroke new fonts), after matching rows within case x interference family x severity and a target-SSIM bin of width 0.05; fonts contribute equally within each group and each case contributes equally.
primary_estimand_units: SSIM units on the 0-1 scale (absolute residual difference)
independent_unit: source group for measurement; matched case cluster for resampling and font contrast
reference_condition: predeclared thick-stroke new-font group under the same fixed renderer, cases and corruption ladder
splits: evaluation-only confirmatory set C; new fonts and new cases not used in M5C training, M8C or pilot P; no font or case crosses a fitting boundary because no fitting is performed
support_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% case-cluster percentile CI for theta_h3 has lower bound > 0.02, and every predeclared per-font sign check holds: each thin font has a higher matched mean absolute residual than the mean of all thick fonts, and each thick font has a lower matched mean absolute residual than the mean of all thin fonts.
falsify_rule: Simultaneous 98.333% case-cluster CI for theta_h3 has upper bound <= 0.02.
inconclusive_rule: Any result not meeting the support or falsification rule; also target-overlap failure, sign-check inconsistency, fewer than 90% of planned matched cases, or precision target not met.
secondary_metrics: per-font matched mean absolute residuals and pairwise font contrasts; target-SSIM distributions by font and severity; severity-specific font-group contrasts; source-grouped bootstrap sensitivity; interference MAE, bias and large-error proportion by font
diagnostic_metrics: clean-reference and s1 target distributions by font; text-length and case composition checks; descriptive comparison against the already observed M8C font ordering, explicitly exploratory
main_confounders: font identity is entangled with glyph shape, stroke width, font metrics and hinting; all fonts use the same fixed renderer, so renderer effects are not varied; the SSIM target is computed against each font's own clean reference, so target construction differs by font; target difficulty differs across fonts and is matched only within finite bins; a small purposive roster of at least two fonts per group is not a font population
what_cannot_be_separated: This design cannot separate a causal font property from glyph shape, font metrics, hinting, rasterisation, target construction or case composition. The small purposive roster (at least two fonts per group) cannot support inference to a font population, an unseen renderer or human difficulty.
new_data_required: Confirmatory set C with at least two new thin-stroke and two new thick-stroke fonts, classified before outcomes by a predeclared external stroke-width measure, all licence-eligible and unused by M5C training, M8C and pilot P. New cases and new seeds are required. The exact roster is frozen after the pilot and before C generation.
followup_if_supported: A separately approved new-font characterisation or font-stratified benchmark may replicate the conditional contrast on a new roster. This protocol does not authorise a model or feature change and does not claim a font-population effect.
followup_if_falsified: Deprioritise the font-specific modifier and do not build a font-specific model or feature on this basis.
followup_if_inconclusive: Increase the matched font roster, improve target overlap or separate the renderer factor in a new pilot; do not reinterpret a failed match as a null font effect.
